Corrects the application and Snap Store icon to the selected artwork: a black8-ball falling into a leather corner pocket, with the white cue ball and cue behind it on green cloth, surrounded by a gold border.

Gameplay is unchanged from0.5.4. Linux x86-64 download: extract the archive and run `TheLastPocket/play.sh`.

Snap Store stable:

```sh
sudo snap install the-last-pocket
# If already installed:
sudo snap refresh the-last-pocket
```

Source is Apache-2.0; bundled music has separate terms in NOTICE.
